decision_summary: Rename a local export before sharing it with a collaborator.
key_assumptions: The rename does not change file contents.

failure_modes.hypothesis: The selected path may refer to a similarly named file.
failure_modes.plausibility_basis: The workspace contains two recent exports with similar names.
failure_modes.material_consequence: The wrong artifact could be shared.
failure_modes.discriminating_evidence: Compare the selected file hash with the intended export manifest.

residual_uncertainty: The collaborator may have an older copy.
authority: Policy finding only; sharing authority remains with the caller.
